details: Numbers run from 100 (thin) to 900 (black); normal is 400 and bold is 700. A font only shows the weights it has; others are approximated or synthesised.

values.note: Semi-bold: a softer emphasis for labels and headings.
One step bolder than the parent.

gotcha: Headings and strong are bold by default. To make a heading regular weight you must set font-weight: 400 on it explicitly.
